title: model3d common definitions
description: Shared $defs of the model3d contracts (3D-06). Units: metres and degrees; coordinates double precision (spec §1.2). Not a message on its own: the root accepts nothing.
$comment: [P] Grouping of shared definitions into one schema is a 3D-06 proposal (D-18).

EntityId.description: Id of a model entity, command, preview or project. v0.2 B.2 `type UUID = string`; the server creates UUIDs at COMMIT, a PREVIEW may use ephemeral ids in an explicit namespace (v0.2 B.6). v0.2 D.3 examples use non-UUID strings ('cmd-001', 'ridge-7'), so the format is not narrowed here; the ephemeral namespace syntax is TBD (Q-3D06-1).

V2.description: Local horizontal coordinates [x, y], metres (v0.2 B.2).

V3.description: Point [x, y, z], metres; frame given by the message (v0.2 B.2, B.6).

Line3.description: A line given by two points, as `targetLine` in v0.2 D.3.

Line2.description: A line in plan given by two points [x, y].
Line2.$comment: [P] Used where only a plan line is meaningful (vertical wall plane, ALIGN_WALL).

Ring2.description: Closed ring in plan; unique coordinates, implicit closing segment (v0.2 B.2 Footprint.outerRing).

Plane.description: Plane `normal · p + d = 0` with |normal| = 1 (v0.2 B.2). The unit length is checked by the kernel, not expressible here.

ConstraintKind.description: v0.2 B.2 + v0.3 §4.2 (`BOUNDARY_ON_FOOTPRINT`, `PREFERRED_AXIS`); hard/soft split in spec §5 rule 1.

Frame.description: Coordinate frame tag of a message (v0.2 D.2 `coordinateFrame`, v0.3 §4.2 Measurement3D.frame).

LocalAxis.description: Building axes, including `buildingAxisDeg` (v0.3 §4.3); `ridgeAxis: LOCAL_X` in v0.2 D.3.

Version.description: Model version number; every commit, Undo and Redo is a new version (v0.2 §13.6).

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time from the injected clock (spec §1.2).
